raw_response:
This plot is small, only 0.41 ha, and it is my main maize for the house to eat. I went to school a little so I know the FISP coupon helps a lot — last year I got one and bought a bag of NPK and a bag of urea at the subsidy price, and I will try for the coupon again this year. If the coupon comes I will use both bags on this plot because maize without fertilizer here gives very little. I intercrop with pigeon pea so I do not need to buy too much seed, and I will use hybrid maize like I did last season because the neighbors who used local seed got less. I cannot afford pesticide and I have no way to irrigate — I wait for the rains like everyone here.
